desc: 薄荷绿大理石展台首屏，痛点编号清单、两栏对比与水浸可洗微距收口
leaf: 液态硅胶耳机充电仓保护套
name: 薄荷绿液态硅胶全包耳机保护套款

shots.intent: 详情页首屏用薄荷主场加双仓错位大理石展台一秒讲清材质与全包主张
shots.textZone: upper-left two-line headline plus one support line, one hairline pill label above the product, one stacked-dot page marker at the upper right

shots.intent: 把全包、可洗、抗摔、防指纹拆成错落白卡图标，白场喘息并证明实力不靠口号
shots.textZone: top-left two-line headline plus one label and one Latin micro-label per card

shots.intent: 用编号清单把缝隙、脱落、太薄三类旧套痛点摊开，先制造共鸣再给方案
shots.textZone: top headline plus one support line, one ordinal marker and one short problem line per card

shots.intent: 深绿底两栏同框对比旧套与本品贴合状态，把材质差异讲成一眼可读的画面差
shots.textZone: top two-line headline plus one caption line under each panel

shots.intent: 回到薄荷点阵主场用一句主张加三枚描边药丸把贴合、卡槽、加厚三点讲完
shots.textZone: upper-centre headline plus one support line and one row of three hairline pill callouts

shots.intent: 白场水线半浸加气泡把可水洗、不串色讲成可见证据而非口号
shots.textZone: upper-left two-line headline plus one dot-and-hairline page marker

shots.intent: 粉绿撞色块上的梯层与接缝掠光微距，用模具精度证明贴合与抗脱落
shots.textZone: upper-right headline plus one support line and one hairline leader label at the step

shots.intent: 俯视随身桌面把保护套放进日常携带语境，用常见物件给出真实尺寸感
shots.textZone: one headline at the upper left and one small label on a hairline leader line

shots.intent: 同款多色横排给买家选择权，同一机位同一光保证色准可比
shots.textZone: centred top headline with hairline rule plus one short label under each unit

shots.intent: 结构化两栏参数表把规格疑问一次答清，全部取值走占位符避免虚构
shots.textZone: centred headline above the table, one field name and one placeholder value per row

shots.intent: 回到首屏薄荷展台用一句主张加圆角按钮收口，与首尾呼应完成转化闭环
shots.textZone: two-line headline above the product, one support line, one rounded action button at the lower centre

style.backgroundSystem: alternating mint #62BFA2 showcase fields carrying a raised-dot relief panel, deep #4C9A84 versus blocks, one blush-pink #F0CFCB block cut by a #4C9A84 diagonal wedge, and #FFFFFF / #F2F3F5 infographic plates; depth comes only from the dot relief and the marble podiums, never from gradients
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight #2D2D2D line icons inside soft #CFEBE1 circles, rounded #FFFFFF cards with hairline dividers, hairline-outlined pill callouts, small stacked-dot page markers and one wave-line glyph as a recurring corner ornament
style.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key studio light at about 6000K from the front-left, gentle wrap on the matte silicone skin, one controlled specular on the gloss inner shell, raking side light for texture macros, and an always-present soft contact shadow under every product and podium
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh soft-touch silicone accessory ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a mint showcase field #62BFA2, a deep sea-green versus block #4C9A84 and a clean copy plate #FFFFFF with one mist-grey card #F2F3F5, accent blush-pink #F0CFCB and one soft secondary pale mint #CFEBE1, text #2D2D2D on light plates and #FFFFFF on green fields with muted #7A8087 field labels; bright soft high-key studio light at about 6000K from the front-left, a gentle wrap on matte silicone, one controlled specular on the gloss inner shell, raking side light for texture macros and a constant soft contact shadow under every item; modern geometric sans-serif with short two-line Chinese headlines wrapped in corner brackets and one hairline rule or hairline pill outline beneath; alternating mint #62BFA2 relief fields carrying a raised-dot texture panel, deep #4C9A84 versus blocks, one blush-pink #F0CFCB block cut by a #4C9A84 diagonal wedge and #FFFFFF / #F2F3F5 infographic plates, depth carried only by the dot relief and never by gradients; shared stage language of white marble cylindrical podiums with grey veining #F2F5F2, matte mint disc plinths, a pale mint #A8DACB tabletop and one clear still-water surface; consistent thin single-weight #2D2D2D line icons inside soft #CFEBE1 circles, rounded #FFFFFF cards with hairline dividers, hairline-outlined pill callouts, small stacked-dot page markers and one wave-line corner glyph; stable product scale and centring, matte silicone skin and gloss inner shell rendered as two separate finishes, colourways taken only from the reference; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented spec numbers.
noDrift: no invented spec numbers or certifications
no warped straight lines or distorted podium ellipses
style.presentationRules: one identical hinge-open case-and-cover silhouette across the set, the matte silicone skin and the gloss inner shell rendered as two separate finishes, the lid always open enough to read the interior wells and the corner lanyard lug, stable scale and centring between screens, colourways taken only from the reference with no recolouring
style.surfaceSystem: white marble cylindrical podiums with grey veining #F2F5F2, matte mint disc plinths, a pale mint #A8DACB tabletop, one clear still-water surface with ripples and small bubbles, and #FFFFFF / #F2F3F5 copy plates for information screens
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; two-line #FFFFFF Chinese headlines on the green fields and #2D2D2D headlines on the light plates, one hairline rule or hairline pill outline beneath every headline, muted #7A8087 field labels, three-layer copy only, Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」 and carried as placeholders
